kpis.signal: Segment Advertising = 68% du CA FY24, croissance accélérée par AXON 2.0 (moteur IA performance ads)
kpis.description_fr: CA du segment Advertising (AppDiscovery + AXON + MAX + Adjust + Wurl). 68% du total FY24. Croissance portée par migration AXON 2.0 et expansion CTV via Wurl.
kpis.description_en: Advertising segment revenue (AppDiscovery + AXON + MAX + Adjust + Wurl). 68% of FY24 total. AXON 2.0 migration + CTV expansion via Wurl driving growth.

kpis.signal: Segment Apps stable, AppLovin se désengage progressivement de la verticale gaming pour focus Advertising

kpis.description_en: Apps = AppLovin mobile games portfolio + IAA revenue. 32% of FY24 total, flat. Strategy shift toward Advertising announced.

kpis.signal: 1.6 Md DAU touches via reseau AppLovin, audience publicitaire massive
kpis.description_fr: Reach quotidien des utilisateurs touches via la plateforme publicitaire AppLovin (cible advertisers).
kpis.description_en: Daily active users reached via AppLovin advertising platform (advertiser targeting scale).

kpis.signal: Adj EBITDA Advertising +91% FY24, +201% sur 2 ans. Operating leverage massif AXON 2.0.

kpis.description_en: Advertising segment Adjusted EBITDA. Explosive growth on AXON 2.0 / AppDiscovery operating leverage.
